questions.explanation: Evidence doesn't have to be paid work - projects, placement, part-time jobs, caring for someone, sport - it all counts.

options: The three with the strongest evidence behind them - not the three that sound best
The ones you've never mentioned before
questions.explanation: Pick the three with the strongest evidence behind them.
